answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method on long-context summarization tasks: QMSum, GovReport and Novel Summarization ... We also evaluate on the HTML to TSV task ... and on a new synthetic task Chain-of-key that requires long-form generation.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form generated text such as summaries, TSV rows, and sequences of keys

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-L for summarization tasks and row-level F-1 score for the HTML to TSV task. We also measure perplexity on language modeling datasets.
